pkgmetadata.longdescription: Windows 11 system fonts packaged like the Arch AUR ttf-ms-win11 split. Portage cannot fetch the files; copy them from a licensed Windows 11 install or ISO into DISTDIR. Extra CJK and regional families are optional USE flags matching the AUR subpackages. These fonts are proprietary; redistribution is not allowed.

use.flag: Install Japanese fonts (MS Gothic, Yu Gothic)
Install Southeast Asian fonts (Nirmala UI, Myanmar Text, and related)
Install Simplified Chinese fonts (SimSun, Microsoft YaHei)
Install Traditional Chinese fonts (Microsoft JhengHei, MingLiU)
Install remaining Windows 11 fonts (Ebrima, Gadugi, MV Boli)
